correctness.rationale: The bijective two-temporal-column transfer construction proves P_n=tr(T^n S) for every n>=3, with no extrapolation from sampled widths. Exact integer matrix computations reproduce the cyclic SCC list, swap action and invariant/anti-invariant characteristic polynomials. Algebraic identification of polynomial roots gives the Lucas formulas. A separate rung-propagation argument gives Q_n. All 5,592,384 labelled configurations for widths 3 through 11 were also directly checked by a second update implementation; this finite enumeration is corroborative only.

value.rationale: Exact period-dividing-two state and primitive two-cycle counts of a natural infinite cubic vertex-transitive graph family, with the odd-width square identity versus even-width Lucas-square corrections caused by the crossed boundary. The precise attractor census is not determined by the known eventual-period bound or the known no-isolated-bit fixed-word count. It is relevant as an exact recurrent-state capacity statistic for Boolean majority networks; no stronger downstream consequence is asserted.
